meta.name: Jab Mila Tu
meta.description: When Maddy and Aneri find themselves sharing a home, things get chaotic. With Mint and Jigar joining the mix, their adventures spiral into unpredictable escapades.

videos.title: What happened in Goa?
videos.overview: Star singer Maddy arrives in Goa for his next show where his biggest Fan Jigar follows him. Aneri, the baker and owner of "Jo's Cafe" gets a rude shock when intruders take possession of her house. How will she deal with them?

videos.title: Baja Diya Guitar
videos.overview: Aneri loses her cafe to her cheater boyfriend, Shaurya. Maddy struggles with old memories as he gets into a fight at a the beach shack. There is a bowl of pasta waiting in the kitchen. Will he get doubtful?

videos.title: You owe me 30D
videos.overview: Aneri is desperate for business as she gets a catering order, not knowing its form Maddy's team. Mint has her hands full as Maddy gets negative PR online. Jigar leaves his number on her bra and a video in her mail.

videos.title: The Secret Girlfriend
videos.overview: A media reporter manages to click a bare back pic of Aneri from one of the windows and it goes viral in no time as "Maddy's secret girlfriend". Media swarms the bungalow and Aneri finds it difficult to get out.

videos.title: The Party, the Mask, the Dance
videos.overview: A wild party at Maddy's bungalow brings Aneri and Maddy together for a dance. Chaos breaks out as Jigar encourages the band members in the party to 'load the gun.

videos.title: Cat in the House
videos.overview: Maddy finds the broken CCTV camera that Mint has installed for his safety. Maddy and Aneri share an awkward moment. Mint introduces Jigar to Maddy again and mentions that he could help Maddy in tracking the Secret Girlfriend's location.

videos.title: Jab Mila Chor
videos.overview: Sparks fly as Maddy finally gets hold of the Secret girlfriend in the bungalow. A glimpse of his fight with her goes viral. Mint runs to catch a glimpse of the imposter, but Prakaas has an interesting story to tell.

videos.title: The blackmailer Bit@#
videos.overview: Maddy feels that he has cracked a deal with Aneri and now she would stop posting his pictures on the secret girlfriend account. Shaurya gets Aneri arrested. Will she have her way out of this mess?

videos.title: The Butler in My Bungalow
videos.overview: Maddy insists Aneri becomes his butler to stay in the bungalow. Aneri, facing a loan reminder, accepts a brand collaboration offer from Mint's Secret Girlfriend Account, delighting Mint. The trap is set to reveal the Secret Girlfriend.

videos.title: A public apology!
videos.overview: Mint surprises Maddy unannounced. Panicking, he urges Aneri to leave, but she won't endure his rude behaviour. Maddy has 10 minutes to devise a plan for her discreet departure. Will he manage it without media attention?

videos.title: Silent Maddy.. Stripper Maddy..Killer Maddy
videos.overview: Maddy looses his voice due to the coffee prepared by Aneri for him due to which he cannot perform at Raj's party. Mint has a plan to sort this out and at the party, Not 1, but 2 Maddy arrives. Has Mint screwed up? How will Maddy react?

videos.title: Mai hoon Momo
videos.overview: Maddy, fed up with Aneri's games, and decides to end it. Maddy tasks Jigar to trick Aneri into revealing the Secret Girlfriend account. If Jigar succeeds Jigar earns a spot in Maddy's next album. Is he up for the challenge?

videos.title: Momo is home
videos.overview: Jigar accidentally crashes into Aneri's car and she gets him home. He straightaway jumps into the drama and pretends to remember the house from his childhood. Will Aneri believe that he is her Momo?

videos.title: Yeh tera ghar..ye mera ghar
videos.overview: Aneri and Jigar are getting closer and this triggers Maddy's jealousy. Amidst Aneri's search for her house's papers, Maddy gets flashes of his childhood. Will he remember Aneri?

videos.title: Jo's cafe on sale
videos.overview: Shaurya is trying to sell her cafe. Jigar promises to get it back. He wants Maddy to be a part of it too, but he refuses and asks Jigar to stick to the plan of getting the password to the SG account. Will Jigar be able to convince Maddy?

videos.title: What I don't like, I kill!
videos.overview: Agent Jigar and Aneri are on a mission to save the cafe, but it turns out that the buyer is a deadly drug mafia. Aneri's life is in danger. Will Maddy reach on time and help her get her cafe back?
